name: Kevin Spencer
tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: The University of South Dakota School of Law
about: Kevin Spencer of Spencer, Johnson, Harvell, & Spencer, PLLC, since 1993, actively and full-time practices in the area of estate, trust, fiduciary litigation in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex, including all counties contiguous to Dallas and Tarrant counties and all over the state of Texas. His litigation focus involves will contests, trust contests, lawsuits involving fiduciaries of all kinds, like executors, administrators, trustees, guardians, attorneys-in-fact, etc., for failing to fulfill their fiduciary duties and obligations. Estate and trust litigation captures multiple other areas of law, including but not limited to heirship disputes, oil & gas disputes, proving or defending against common-law spouse claims, evaluating and defending against creditor's claims, survivorship and Pay-On-Death beneficiary designations, survival and wrongful death claims, contract claims.

Kevin has been an AV* rated attorney (peer review rating) since 2003 and was selected as a Texas Super Lawyer in the area of Estate and Trust Litigation every year since 2011. Before that, he was named by Texas Monthly - SuperLawyers as a Rising Star in 2004-2005 and 2007 and was listed as one of Best Lawyers in Dallas Under 40 in a 2006 issue of D Magazine.

Kevin has written papers and given speeches at Continuing Legal Education Seminars and numerous state bar sections, including the Fiduciary Litigation CLE, the Tarrant County Bar Probate Litigation Seminar, the Family Law Section of the State Bar of Texas. Recently, he was invited to speak on estate and trust litigation topics at the prestigious Hawai'i Tax Institute in 2024 (61st Annual) and 2025 (62nd Annual). He has authored a number of papers on estate and trust litigation matters, including being twice published in the Texas Tech School of Law Estate Planning and Community Property Law Journal, (1) Good Estate Planning Process: A Panacea for Litigation , 11 Tex. Tech Est. Plan. & Com. Prop. L.J. 137-150 (February 2019) and (2) Standing and Error Correction in Probate , Tex. Tech Est. Plan. & Com. Prop. L. J., Vol. 10, No. 1 (Summer 2018).

*AV Preeminent and BV Distinguished are certification marks of Reed Elsevier Properties Inc., used in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies.
